about: Chester is a municipal district on Nova Scotia’s South Shore, centred on the harbour village of Chester—not a city. Yacht harbours, coastal islands, and inland forest communities share Mahone Bay approaches and Lunenburg County scenery. About 10,000 people live in Chester MD.
seoSummary: Nova Scotia South Shore municipal district around Chester harbour—yacht village and coastal islands, not a city.
